Ezreal.build: Build critical strike items first to increase Nilah Q Formless Blade’s armor penetration and basic attack lifesteal. Ezreal Q Mystic Shot deals physical damage, while Ezreal W Essence Flux and Ezreal E Arcane Shift deal magic damage, so build resistances without focusing on only one type.
Ezreal.watch: Dodge Ezreal Q Mystic Shot by keeping minions between you and him. If Ezreal W Essence Flux marks you, his next basic attack or ability deals extra damage, so briefly move out of range. When low on health, don’t retreat in a straight line with allies because of Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage.
Ezreal.combo: First, make a short engage to force Ezreal to use Ezreal E Arcane Shift. When you go in again, cast Nilah Q Formless Blade during Nilah E Slipstream, then land basic attacks. Activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil when a retaliatory basic attack starts, then pull him in and finish with Nilah R Apotheosis.
Ezreal.escape: Immediately after Ezreal E Arcane Shift has been used is your chance to close the gap with Nilah E Slipstream. However, if Ezreal Q Mystic Shot keeps landing, his escape spell comes back sooner, so approach with minions between you. Before going in, identify a unit to dash to with Nilah E Slipstream when disengaging.
Ezreal.fight: For a short trade, hit a minion or Ezreal with Nilah Q Formless Blade to activate its empowered effect, then land basic attacks. Make Ezreal use Ezreal E Arcane Shift, then close the gap with Nilah E Slipstream and look for an all-in. Use Nilah W Jubilant Veil when Ezreal starts a retaliatory basic attack.
Ezreal.laning: Move among minions to block Ezreal Q Mystic Shot, and look for an engage when Ezreal steps forward to last-hit. Stay near your support to benefit from Nilah P Joy Unending’s experience bonus.
Ezreal.phase: From mid game, as critical strike items build up, Nilah Q Formless Blade’s penetration and lifesteal increase, making her stronger in fights. In the late game, enter second and help allies survive with Nilah W Jubilant Veil and Nilah R Apotheosis.
Ezreal.teamfight: Create vision and an angle to approach Ezreal instead of trading poke with him from long range. Enter second, after the enemy’s engage spell is used on an ally, and dodge basic attack damage with Nilah W Jubilant Veil. When enemies group up, pull them in and finish with Nilah R Apotheosis, healing nearby allies as well.

Samira.fight: For short trades, hit a minion or Samira with Nilah Q Formless Blade to empower it, then use basic attacks. Keep the trade short so Samira can't hit you with different types of attacks and build toward her ultimate. When Samira's basic attacks start coming in, activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil.
Samira.build: Prioritize armor against the physical damage from Samira Q Flair, Samira W Blade Whirl, and Samira R Inferno Trigger. Then increase your critical strike chance to also boost the armor penetration and life steal on basic attacks from Nilah Q Formless Blade.
Samira.combo: Once Samira E Wild Rush is down, go in with Nilah E Slipstream and cast Nilah Q Formless Blade during the dash to hit enemies along your path. Follow up with basic attacks, then activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil when Samira starts counterattacking with basic attacks. Pull her in with Nilah R Apotheosis to finish her.
Samira.escape: If Samira has used Samira E Wild Rush and no one has died, go in while the dash has not reset. Wait until the enemy support's key immobilizing ability is down, then close the distance with Nilah E Slipstream. Before engaging, also check for a minion to dash to on the way out.
Samira.laning: Early on, don't force an engage. Use Nilah Q Formless Blade to last-hit from a distance and keep up in levels. Stay near your support for experience and increased shielding and healing, and look for an engage when Samira steps forward to hit a minion.
Samira.phase: From mid game, as you build critical strike items, Nilah Q Formless Blade gains penetration and life steal, improving your ability to sustain fights. In late-game teamfights, protect your allies with Nilah W Jubilant Veil and Nilah R Apotheosis.
Samira.teamfight: Wait for the first engage, then go in second and use Nilah W Jubilant Veil to dodge Samira's basic attacks. When Samira R Inferno Trigger starts, interrupt it with the pull from Nilah R Apotheosis, hitting grouped enemies as well to heal nearby allies. When retreating, leave low-health allies behind you so Samira can't reset Samira E Wild Rush.
Samira.watch: Samira can use an ally's immobilizing effect to dash in, so dodge the enemy support's engage ability first. When Samira R Inferno Trigger starts, interrupt it with the pull from Nilah R Apotheosis.

Aphelios.teamfight: Spread out from allies before engaging so Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil doesn’t hit several of you. Enter second, after the enemy has committed to an ally, dodge their basic attack damage with Nilah W Jubilant Veil, and pull them in with Nilah R Apotheosis when they group up. Hit multiple champions with Nilah R Apotheosis to heal nearby allies as well.
Aphelios.build: Build armor first against Aphelios’s main damage. If healing makes fights drag on, fit Executioner's Calling between core items, then build critical strike items to increase Nilah Q Formless Blade’s penetration and lifesteal.
Aphelios.combo: After Aphelios’s root threat is down, engage with Nilah E Slipstream and cast Nilah Q Formless Blade during the dash to hit enemies along its path. Follow with basic attacks, then use Nilah W Jubilant Veil to dodge when Aphelios starts a retaliatory basic attack. When enemies group up, pull them in and finish with Nilah R Apotheosis.
Aphelios.escape: Delay your engage while Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites, E Weapon Queue System, or R Moonlight Vigil can immobilize you. Once those threats are down and Aphelios is not holding Severum, close the gap with Nilah E Slipstream. Before going in, identify a minion to dash to when disengaging so you don’t spend every charge of Nilah E Slipstream on the engage.
Aphelios.fight: Check the next weapon in Aphelios E Weapon Queue System and trade during weapon windows with low immediate damage. First hit a minion or Aphelios with Nilah Q Formless Blade to gain range and attack speed, then land basic attacks. Before committing, identify a unit to use as a way back, then close the gap with Nilah E Slipstream.
Aphelios.laning: Early on, avoid forcing an engage on ranged Aphelios and use Nilah Q Formless Blade to last-hit. Look for an angle to engage with Nilah E Slipstream when Aphelios steps forward to hit minions. Back off when marked by Calibrum and preserve your health; stay near your support to benefit from experience, shields, and healing.
Aphelios.phase: From mid game, as critical strike items build up, Nilah Q Formless Blade’s penetration and lifesteal increase, making her stronger. In the late game, fight while keeping allies alive with Nilah W Jubilant Veil and Nilah R Apotheosis.
Aphelios.watch: When Aphelios’s Gravitum basic attack slows you, watch for the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites and immediately move out of range. Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil detonates when it hits a champion and applies his main-hand weapon attack to everyone hit, so spread out from your allies when he can use it.

Lucian.combo: When Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is down and the enemy team has no immobilizing crowd control available, go in with Nilah E Slipstream and cast Nilah Q Formless Blade during the dash. Follow up with basic attacks, then activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil when Lucian starts counterattacking with basic attacks. In that opening, while Lucian has trouble escaping, pull him in with Nilah R Apotheosis to finish him.
Lucian.escape: Right after Lucian uses Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is a brief window to go in with Nilah E Slipstream. However, wait if the enemy team still has immobilizing crowd control available. Before engaging, check for a minion to dash to on the way out so you don't spend all of Nilah E Slipstream going in.
Lucian.build: Prioritize armor against the physical damage from Lucian Q Piercing Light and Lucian R The Culling. Then build critical strike items to also increase the armor penetration and life steal on basic attacks from Nilah Q Formless Blade.
Lucian.fight: For short trades, hit a minion or Lucian with Nilah Q Formless Blade first to activate its range and attack speed bonuses, then use basic attacks. Once Lucian's first combo and Lucian E Relentless Pursuit are down, use Nilah E Slipstream to close the distance and continue the fight.
Lucian.laning: Stay close to your support to benefit from Nilah P Joy Unending's bonus experience and increased shielding and healing. Look for an engage when Lucian steps forward to hit a minion, but avoid the path of Lucian Q Piercing Light.
Lucian.phase: From mid game, as you build critical strike items, Nilah Q Formless Blade gains penetration and life steal, giving you more power to sustain fights. In late-game teamfights, help your allies survive with Nilah W Jubilant Veil and Nilah R Apotheosis.
Lucian.teamfight: Don't engage first; wait until the enemy's engage reaches an ally, then go in second. Use Nilah W Jubilant Veil to dodge Lucian's basic attacks while passing by your support to share its dodge effect. When enemies group up, hit those along your path with Nilah Q Formless Blade during Nilah E Slipstream, then pull them in with Nilah R Apotheosis to heal nearby allies as well.
Lucian.watch: Lucian Q Piercing Light passes through minions and reaches beyond its indicated range, so move out of the line behind the minion Lucian is hitting. Lucian R The Culling cannot change direction while channeling, so dodge sideways instead of running straight back. When Lucian's empowered basic attacks start coming in, dodge them with Nilah W Jubilant Veil.

Kaisa.laning: Early on, Nilah should avoid forcing engages and use Nilah Q Formless Blade to last-hit from range. Farm near your support to benefit from the experience bonus, and don’t stray from allied minions when facing Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain.
Kaisa.build: Build critical strike items to increase the armor penetration and basic attack lifesteal from Nilah Q Formless Blade. Build armor first against Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain and her basic attacks. If it’s difficult to kill Kai'Sa in one go, also consider Kai'Sa P Second Skin and Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, which armor can’t block, and build both magic resistance and health.
Kaisa.combo: Follow with basic attacks, then activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil when Kai'Sa starts a retaliatory basic attack. When Kai'Sa is close or several enemies are grouped together, pull them in with Nilah R Apotheosis to finish.
Kaisa.escape: Kai'Sa E Supercharge increases her movement speed, so it’s easier to close the gap if she has already used it. Before engaging, identify a minion to dash to with Nilah E Slipstream when disengaging.
Kaisa.fight: For a short trade, first hit a minion or Kai'Sa with Nilah Q Formless Blade to gain range and attack speed, then land basic attacks. Close the gap with Nilah E Slipstream when Kai'Sa steps forward to hit minions or after Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct is down. Dodge with Nilah W Jubilant Veil when Kai'Sa starts a retaliatory basic attack.
Kaisa.phase: From mid game, as critical strike items build up, Nilah Q Formless Blade’s penetration and lifesteal increase, improving her staying power in fights. In the late game, watch out for Kai'Sa’s sustained damage and protect allies too with Nilah W Jubilant Veil and Nilah R Apotheosis.
Kaisa.teamfight: Don’t engage before your allies; wait until you see Kai'Sa engage with R Killer Instinct or the enemy’s first engage, then go in. When Kai'Sa’s basic attacks start coming in, dodge them with Nilah W Jubilant Veil. Right after Kai'Sa dashes in with R, use Nilah R Apotheosis to pull her in and create a chance to catch her. When several enemies group up, hit them with Nilah R Apotheosis to heal nearby allies as well.
Kaisa.watch: If you’re hit by Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, you can become a target for Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, so retreat toward your allies until the mark disappears. Stand near allied minions to spread out the missiles from Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain. If you’re low on health and stacks of Kai'Sa P Second Skin have built up, wait out of range for the stacks to expire.

MissFortune.phase: Early on, your range and health are at a disadvantage, so keep up in levels without falling too far behind. From mid game, as you build critical strike items, Nilah Q Formless Blade gains penetration and life steal, improving your ability to sustain fights. In late-game teamfights, fight while helping your allies survive with Nilah W Jubilant Veil and Nilah R Apotheosis.
MissFortune.build: Nilah Q Formless Blade grants armor penetration and life steal on basic attacks based on critical strike chance, so prioritize critical strike items. Build armor to withstand Miss Fortune's main damage. However, armor does not block the magic damage from Miss Fortune E Make It Rain.
MissFortune.combo: For an all-in, use Nilah E Slipstream to go in while casting Nilah Q Formless Blade to hit enemies along your path, then follow up with basic attacks. When Miss Fortune's counterattacking basic attacks start coming in, activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil. Then pull her in with Nilah R Apotheosis to finish her; use it to interrupt if Miss Fortune R Bullet Time has started.
MissFortune.escape: Miss Fortune has no ability to create distance on her own, so look for an opening to engage with Nilah E Slipstream from outside the area of Miss Fortune E Make It Rain. If you spend all of Nilah E Slipstream going in, you'll have trouble getting out, so check your return dash target before engaging.
MissFortune.fight: When Miss Fortune steps forward to hit a minion, first land Nilah Q Formless Blade to activate its range and attack speed bonuses, then use a few basic attacks. If you have an opening to engage, use Nilah E Slipstream to close the distance, but check beforehand which unit you can dash to on the way out. When Miss Fortune starts counterattacking with basic attacks, dodge with Nilah W Jubilant Veil.
MissFortune.laning: Immediately after Miss Fortune hits a minion, back away to avoid her empowered basic attack poke, and don't stand directly behind a minion. Stay near your support to benefit from Nilah P Joy Unending's experience and increased shielding and healing.
MissFortune.teamfight: Avoid the first engage and go in second, after the enemy reaches an ally. Hold off on engaging in the area covered by Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, and look for a chance to interrupt with the pull from Nilah R Apotheosis when Miss Fortune R Bullet Time starts. When the enemy team groups up, pull them together with Nilah R Apotheosis and heal alongside your allies.
MissFortune.watch: Miss Fortune Q Double Up bounces behind a minion, so don't stand in line with one. When Miss Fortune E Make It Rain is placed, Miss Fortune R Bullet Time can overlap its slowing area, so move out of the area. When Bullet Time starts, interrupt it with the pull from Nilah R Apotheosis or move out to the side of the cone.

Ziggs.watch: If Nilah steps on Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield, the slow makes it harder to dodge his follow-up abilities, so take a route without mines or wait until they disappear. Check whether Ziggs W Satchel Charge has been used, since it can knock back Nilah as she engages and move Ziggs. When the warning area for Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb appears, move away from the center of the blast even if you can’t get completely out of range.
Ziggs.build: Prioritize crit items to increase the armor penetration and basic attack lifesteal from Nilah Q Formless Blade. If you build resistance against Ziggs’s damage, choose magic resistance over armor. Move speed is also useful for walking out of the landing zones of Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb and Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb.
Ziggs.combo: After Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down, engage with Nilah E Slipstream. Cast Nilah Q Formless Blade while dashing through to hit enemies along your path. Follow up with basic attacks, then activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil when Ziggs P Short Fuse’s empowered basic attack comes in. Use Nilah R Apotheosis when catching Ziggs and finishing him off.
Ziggs.escape: Ziggs W Satchel Charge lets him reposition and force movement, so engage right after he uses it to poke or clear the wave. Avoid paths covered by Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield and approach with Nilah E Slipstream. Before engaging, check for minions you can use to disengage.
Ziggs.fight: For short trades, hit a minion or Ziggs with Nilah Q Formless Blade to gain range and attack speed, then follow up with a basic attack. Close the distance with Nilah E Slipstream when Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down and there’s a mine-free path to engage. Use Nilah W Jubilant Veil to dodge Ziggs P Short Fuse’s empowered basic attack.
Ziggs.laning: Early on, don’t force an engage against ranged Ziggs. Last-hit with Nilah Q Formless Blade and keep pace in levels. Look for an engage when Ziggs steps forward to hit minions and has used Ziggs W Satchel Charge. Stay near your support to share the experience bonus from Nilah P Joy Unending.
Ziggs.phase: From mid game, as you build crit items, Nilah Q Formless Blade’s penetration and lifesteal both increase, making you stronger in extended fights. In late-game teamfights, use Nilah W Jubilant Veil and Nilah R Apotheosis to protect your allies as you fight.
Ziggs.teamfight: Avoid the first engage and go in second, after the enemy has committed onto your allies. If Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down, approach with Nilah E Slipstream, but go around Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield. When enemies group up, pull them together with Nilah R Apotheosis to combine with your allies’ area damage, and heal nearby allies as well.

Ashe.combo: Land Nilah Q Formless Blade first to activate its empowered effect, then land a short series of basic attacks. For an all-in, engage with Nilah E Slipstream while casting Nilah Q Formless Blade, then follow with basic attacks and activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil when Ashe starts her retaliatory basic attacks. Then pull her in and finish with Nilah R Apotheosis.
Ashe.escape: Ashe has no mobility spell, so engage with Nilah E Slipstream after Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is down. The fight is even more favorable if Ashe W Volley is down and Ashe Q Ranger's Focus has ended. Before going in, identify a minion to use as a way out with Nilah E Slipstream.
Ashe.fight: For a short trade, hit a minion or Ashe with Nilah Q Formless Blade to increase your range and attack speed, then land basic attacks. Close the gap with Nilah E Slipstream when Ashe W Volley and Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow are both down. Use Nilah W Jubilant Veil to dodge when Ashe starts a retaliatory basic attack.
Ashe.laning: Stay near your support to gain the experience bonus from Nilah P Joy Unending and benefit from shields and healing. Look for the moment Ashe steps forward to hit minions and Ashe W Volley is down.
Ashe.phase: From mid game, as critical strike items build up, Nilah Q Formless Blade’s armor penetration and basic attack lifesteal both increase, improving her staying power in fights. In late-game teamfights, protect allies too with Nilah W Jubilant Veil and Nilah R Apotheosis.
Ashe.teamfight: Avoid the first engage and enter second, after the enemy commits to an ally. Dive in while dodging Ashe’s basic attack damage with Nilah W Jubilant Veil, then pull enemies in with Nilah R Apotheosis when they group up to heal allies as well. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available, delay your engage so you aren’t hit and interrupted first.
Ashe.watch: Ashe P Frost Shot’s slow refreshes with every basic attack, so don’t stay in her basic attack range for long. Dodge Ashe W Volley sideways, and don’t start a small fight from out of vision while Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available. When Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active, create distance and engage after it ends.

Caitlyn.build: First, get tenacity to reduce the root duration from Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap and movement speed to close the gap. Build armor to resist Caitlyn’s main physical damage. Later, more critical strike chance also increases Nilah Q Formless Blade’s armor penetration and basic attack lifesteal.
Caitlyn.combo: Land Nilah Q Formless Blade in advance to activate its empowered effect. When engaging with Nilah E Slipstream, cast Nilah Q Formless Blade during the dash to hit enemies along its path. Follow with basic attacks, then activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil when Caitlyn starts a retaliatory basic attack. Once you’re on her, pull her in and finish with Nilah R Apotheosis.
Caitlyn.escape: Engage after Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap is down to reduce the risk of being interrupted by its root. Before going in, also look for a path out using minions as stepping stones.
Caitlyn.fight: For a short trade, hit a minion or Caitlyn with Nilah Q Formless Blade to increase your range and attack speed, then land basic attacks. Look for the moment Caitlyn steps forward to hit minions or just after Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker clears the wave. Use Nilah W Jubilant Veil to dodge when Caitlyn starts a retaliatory basic attack.
Caitlyn.laning: Stay near your support to benefit from Nilah P Joy Unending’s experience bonus and the increased effects of healing and shields. Even if you simply avoid giving up kills and farm under your turret in the early game, the matchup improves as time goes on.
Caitlyn.phase: From mid game, Nilah gets stronger as critical strike items build up and Nilah Q Formless Blade’s penetration and lifesteal increase. In late-game teamfights, fight while keeping allies alive with Nilah W Jubilant Veil and Nilah R Apotheosis.
Caitlyn.teamfight: Avoid the first engage and enter second, after the enemy commits to an ally. Dodge basic attacks with Nilah W Jubilant Veil while passing close to allies to share the dodge effect. When enemies group up, pull them in with Nilah R Apotheosis to overlap with your allies’ area-of-effect abilities and heal nearby allies as well.
Caitlyn.watch: If you step on Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap, you can be rooted in place and take heavy damage from Caitlyn P Headshot, so avoid traps in brush and narrow paths when engaging. When Caitlyn pokes with Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker, stand behind an allied minion so it gets hit first.

Draven.build: Build critical strike items because higher critical strike chance increases Nilah Q Formless Blade’s armor penetration and basic attack lifesteal. Build armor first for resistance against Draven’s main damage, and also pay attention to the health needed to stay outside the execute range of Draven R Whirling Death.
Draven.escape: Engage with Nilah E Slipstream after Draven E Stand Aside is down and Draven has one or fewer Draven Q Spinning Axe. Before going in, identify a minion to dash to when disengaging so you don’t spend every charge of Nilah E Slipstream on the engage.
Draven.fight: For a short trade, hit a minion or Draven with Nilah Q Formless Blade to gain range and attack speed, then land basic attacks. Close the gap with Nilah E Slipstream when Draven has one or fewer Draven Q Spinning Axe and Draven E Stand Aside is down. Dodge with Nilah W Jubilant Veil when Draven starts a retaliatory basic attack.
Draven.laning: If trading is difficult, farm without giving up a kill, and look for an engage when Draven steps forward to hit minions. Stay close to your support to benefit from Nilah P Joy Unending’s experience bonus and the increased effects of shields and healing.
Draven.phase: Nilah is weak early, while Draven is strong when holding two axes, so play safely. From mid game, as critical strike items build up, Nilah Q Formless Blade’s penetration and lifesteal increase, improving her staying power in fights. In the late game, help allies with Nilah W Jubilant Veil and Nilah R Apotheosis, and work with your team to target Draven when he is alone.
Draven.teamfight: Avoid the first engage and enter second, after the enemy commits to an ally. Use Nilah W Jubilant Veil to dodge Draven’s basic attacks and share the dodge effect with nearby allies. When enemies group up, pull them in with Nilah R Apotheosis to combine with your allies’ area damage, hitting multiple champions to heal nearby allies as well.
Draven.watch: Avoid early trades while Draven is holding two Draven Q Spinning Axe. Don’t engage with Nilah E Slipstream while Draven E Stand Aside’s knockback and slow are available. After dodging Draven R Whirling Death once, move out of its return path to avoid its execute.

Jhin.build: Build critical strike items because higher critical strike chance increases Nilah Q Formless Blade’s armor penetration and basic attack lifesteal. Build armor first against Jhin’s main damage. Armor does not block the magic damage from Jhin E Captive Audience.
Jhin.combo: As you engage, cast Nilah Q Formless Blade while Nilah E Slipstream carries you through Jhin to hit enemies along your path as well. Follow with basic attacks, then activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil when Jhin starts a retaliatory basic attack. Pull Jhin in with Nilah R Apotheosis so he can’t escape, then finish him.
Jhin.escape: Jhin has no ability to create distance on his own, so engage with Nilah E Slipstream after Jhin W Deadly Flourish is down. Look for when Jhin is reloading or has just fired one or two shots; wait if his final shot is still loaded. Before going in, identify a minion to dash to with Nilah E Slipstream when disengaging.
Jhin.fight: For a short trade, hit a minion or Jhin with Nilah Q Formless Blade to increase your range and attack speed, then land basic attacks. Close the gap with Nilah E Slipstream while Jhin is reloading or after he has fired one or two shots, if Jhin W Deadly Flourish is also down. Use Nilah W Jubilant Veil when Jhin starts a retaliatory basic attack.
Jhin.laning: Stand one step away from the wave so you aren't hit by Jhin Q Dancing Grenade bouncing toward you after being empowered by killing a minion. Stay close to your support to benefit from Nilah P Joy Unending’s experience bonus and the benefits of shields and healing.
Jhin.phase: From mid game, as critical strike items build up, Nilah Q Formless Blade’s penetration and lifesteal both increase, helping her sustain fights longer. In late-game teamfights, fight while protecting allies with Nilah W Jubilant Veil and Nilah R Apotheosis.
Jhin.teamfight: Let the frontline take Jhin’s traps and the threat of Jhin W Deadly Flourish first, then enter second. When enemies group up, cast Nilah Q Formless Blade during Nilah E Slipstream and pull them in with Nilah R Apotheosis, healing nearby allies as well. If someone must block a shot from Jhin R Curtain Call, the ally with the highest percentage of health should take it.
Jhin.watch: The final shot of Jhin P Whisper deals heavy damage, so count his remaining shots and back off for the last one. Immediately after Jhin hits you with a basic attack or you step on Jhin E Captive Audience, watch for the root from Jhin W Deadly Flourish and move out of its line. When low on health, dodge Jhin R Curtain Call. Stand away from low-health minions so you aren’t hit by an empowered Jhin Q Dancing Grenade.

Jinx.build: Build critical strike items because higher critical strike chance increases Nilah Q Formless Blade’s armor penetration and basic attack lifesteal. Build armor first to withstand Jinx’s main damage. Armor does not block the magic damage from Jinx E Flame Chompers!.
Jinx.combo: First land Nilah Q Formless Blade to activate its empowered effect, then land a short series of basic attacks. For an all-in, engage with Nilah E Slipstream while casting Nilah Q Formless Blade, then follow with basic attacks. Activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil when Jinx starts a retaliatory basic attack, then finish her at her trapped position with Nilah R Apotheosis.
Jinx.escape: The window to engage is when Jinx E Flame Chompers! misses or has already been used. In a teamfight, you can also close the gap with Nilah E Slipstream when the slow from Jinx W Zap! misses. Before going in, identify a minion or other unit to dash to with Nilah E Slipstream when disengaging.
Jinx.fight: For a short trade, first hit a minion or Jinx with Nilah Q Formless Blade to increase your range and attack speed, then land basic attacks. If Jinx is poking with rockets and has also used Jinx E Flame Chompers!, close the gap with Nilah E Slipstream. Use Nilah W Jubilant Veil when Jinx starts a retaliatory basic attack.
Jinx.laning: Even if Jinx steps forward to hit minions, engage with Nilah E Slipstream only after Jinx E Flame Chompers! is down. Stay close to your support to benefit from the experience bonus and increased effects of shields and healing.
Jinx.phase: From mid game, as critical strike items build up, Nilah Q Formless Blade’s penetration and lifesteal both increase, making her stronger in fights. In the late game, fight while keeping allies alive too with Nilah W Jubilant Veil and Nilah R Apotheosis.
Jinx.teamfight: Let an ally start the engage and enter second. After Jinx E Flame Chompers! is down, approach with Nilah E Slipstream. When Jinx’s basic attack damage comes in, use Nilah W Jubilant Veil to protect yourself and allies you touch. If enemies group up, pull them together and deal damage with Nilah R Apotheosis, healing nearby allies as well.
Jinx.watch: If you engage with Nilah E Slipstream while Jinx E Flame Chompers!'s root is available, you will be rooted at close range. When Jinx attacks minions with rockets, avoid standing beside them so you don’t take the area damage too. If health has dropped, watch out for the finishing damage from Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket!

Kalista.build: Nilah Q Formless Blade gains armor penetration and life steal on basic attacks based on critical strike chance, so build critical strike items. Prioritize armor against the physical damage from Kalista Q Pierce and Kalista E Rend. Armor does not block the magic damage from Kalista W Sentinel, which scales with maximum health.
Kalista.combo: Before engaging, hit with Nilah Q Formless Blade to activate its empowered effect. Use Nilah E Slipstream to go in, casting Nilah Q Formless Blade during the dash to hit enemies along your path as well. Follow up with basic attacks, then activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil when Kalista starts counterattacking with basic attacks. When the enemy team groups up, pull them in with Nilah R Apotheosis to finish the fight.
Kalista.escape: When Kalista R Fate's Call is down, look for an opportunity to engage with Nilah E Slipstream. Kalista P Martial Poise's hop depends on her basic attack animation, so read when that animation is about to start and hit her with Nilah Q Formless Blade. Before going in, also check which minion you can dash to on the way out with Nilah E Slipstream.
Kalista.fight: For short trades, hit a minion or Kalista with Nilah Q Formless Blade first to increase your range and attack speed, then use basic attacks. When Kalista starts attacking and dealing sustained damage, use Nilah W Jubilant Veil to dodge her basic attacks. When Kalista steps forward to hit a minion and Kalista R Fate's Call is down, use Nilah E Slipstream to close the distance.
Kalista.laning: Early on, don't force an engage with Nilah's short range. Use Nilah Q Formless Blade to last-hit from a distance and keep up in levels. Last-hit near your support to benefit from Nilah P Joy Unending's bonus experience and its increased healing and shielding for allies. If Kalista has stuck several spears in you, back away from the lane; when you can break vision, retreat into a brush or behind a wall.
Kalista.phase: From mid game, as you build critical strike items, Nilah Q Formless Blade gains penetration and life steal, improving your ability to sustain fights. In late-game teamfights, help your allies survive with Nilah W Jubilant Veil and Nilah R Apotheosis.
Kalista.teamfight: If Kalista brings her support close to her, spread out in anticipation of the landing from Kalista R Fate's Call. Wait until the enemy's engage reaches an ally before going in second. Use Nilah W Jubilant Veil to dodge basic attacks, passing by allies to share its dodge effect. When the enemy team groups up, pull them in with Nilah R Apotheosis alongside your allies' area-of-effect abilities, and heal nearby allies.
Kalista.watch: Kalista stacks spears with basic attacks, then deals their stored damage with Kalista E Rend. If spears stack up and health drops, stop fighting and back away until they disappear. Kalista R Fate's Call throws her support into a fight, so spread out when the support moves next to Kalista to avoid the landing.

KogMaw.build: Nilah Q Formless Blade grants armor penetration and life steal on basic attacks based on critical strike chance, so build critical strike items. Prioritize magic resistance to withstand Kog'Maw's magic damage, and consider armor against his basic attacks as well. Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage deals damage based on your maximum health, so don't rely on stacking health alone.
KogMaw.combo: Hit with Nilah Q Formless Blade first to activate its empowered effect, then go in with Nilah E Slipstream once Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends. Cast Nilah Q Formless Blade while dashing through with Nilah E Slipstream to hit enemies along your path as well, then follow up with basic attacks. When retaliatory basic attacks start, activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil and pull enemies in with Nilah R Apotheosis to finish the fight.
KogMaw.escape: Kog'Maw has no mobility ability, so look to close the distance after the long range of Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends. Go in with Nilah E Slipstream once the slow from Kog'Maw E Void Ooze is down and you've dodged Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle. Before engaging, check for a minion to dash to on the way out; don't spend all of Nilah E Slipstream going in.
KogMaw.fight: For short trades, hit a minion or Kog'Maw with Nilah Q Formless Blade to activate its range and attack speed bonuses, then use basic attacks. Once Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends, use Nilah E Slipstream to close the distance. When Kog'Maw's basic attacks start coming in, activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil to dodge them.
KogMaw.laning: Nilah's short range makes last-hitting difficult early, so use Nilah Q Formless Blade to last-hit from a distance and keep up in levels. Stay near your support to benefit from Nilah P Joy Unending's bonus experience and increased healing and shielding. Look for an engage when Kog'Maw steps forward to hit a minion and Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage has ended.
KogMaw.phase: From mid game, as you build critical strike items, Nilah Q Formless Blade gains penetration and life steal, improving your ability to sustain fights. Kog'Maw is also a hypercarry who grows stronger as the game goes on, so take towers and objectives in the early and mid game and play to end the game quickly.
KogMaw.teamfight: Avoid the first engage and go in second, after the enemy reaches an ally. Use Nilah W Jubilant Veil to dodge Kog'Maw's basic attacks while passing by an ally to share the dodge effect. When the enemy team groups up, cast Nilah Q Formless Blade during Nilah E Slipstream and pull them in with Nilah R Apotheosis to heal nearby allies as well.
KogMaw.watch: When Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, his range and basic attack damage increase, so keep your distance until it expires. Dodge Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle from behind minions; if it hits, don't engage while your armor and magic resistance are reduced. When your health is low, Kog'Maw R Living Artillery deals more damage, so leave his sight and recover. After killing Kog'Maw, move away from his corpse to avoid the explosion from Kog'Maw P Icathian Surprise.

Senna.build: Prioritize armor against Senna's main damage, and build health alongside it. If healing from Senna Q Piercing Darkness prolongs fights, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items. Then increase your critical strike chance to also boost the armor penetration and life steal on basic attacks from Nilah Q Formless Blade.
Senna.combo: If Senna W Last Embrace is down, go in with Nilah E Slipstream and cast Nilah Q Formless Blade during the dash to hit enemies along your path as well. Follow up with basic attacks, then activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil when Senna counterattacks with basic attacks. Use Nilah R Apotheosis to catch and finish Senna.
Senna.escape: If Senna W Last Embrace is available, delay a close-range engage and go in with Nilah E Slipstream once it is down. Senna has no mobility ability to create distance, so look for a chance to pull her in with Nilah R Apotheosis and finish her once you get close. Before engaging, check for a minion to dash to on the way out, and don't spend all of Nilah E Slipstream going in.
Senna.fight: For short trades, hit a minion or Senna with Nilah Q Formless Blade to empower it, then use basic attacks. Once Senna W Last Embrace is down and Senna steps forward toward a minion or a soul, use Nilah E Slipstream to close the distance. When Senna starts a counterattack with basic attacks, block them with Nilah W Jubilant Veil.
Senna.laning: Early on, don't force an engage. Use Nilah Q Formless Blade to last-hit from a distance and keep up in levels. Watch where Senna will step to collect souls and poke her to disrupt her mist collection. Stay in lane with your support to benefit from Nilah's bonus experience and increased shielding and healing.
Senna.phase: Senna also has low health early, so pressure her when Senna W Last Embrace is down to stop her from collecting mist. In mid game, Nilah's penetration and life steal grow stronger as she builds critical strike items. In late game, contribute to teamfights with Nilah W Jubilant Veil and Nilah R Apotheosis while watching out for Senna's growing range and attack damage.
Senna.teamfight: Don't engage first; wait until the enemy reaches an ally, then go in second. If Senna E Curse of the Black Mist appears, back away to gain vision or use Nilah's area-of-effect abilities in its range. Once in, use Nilah W Jubilant Veil to dodge basic attacks, then pull grouped enemies in with Nilah R Apotheosis to heal nearby allies as well.
Senna.watch: Don't go in with Nilah E Slipstream while Senna W Last Embrace is available. Dodge Senna W Last Embrace from behind minions; if it hits, move away from allies before the root lands. Dodge Senna Q Piercing Darkness by moving out of the line between Senna and an ally or a minion in front. If it hits once, back away to avoid a second hit.

Seraphine.build: If healing from Seraphine W Surround Sound prolongs fights, buy Executioner's Calling between your core items. Prioritize magic resistance over armor to withstand Seraphine's damage. Then build critical strike items to also increase the armor penetration and life steal on basic attacks from Nilah Q Formless Blade.
Seraphine.combo: To engage, use Nilah E Slipstream through Seraphine and cast Nilah Q Formless Blade during the dash to hit enemies along your path as well, then follow up with basic attacks. Activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil when the enemy's basic attacks actually start coming in. Pull Seraphine in with Nilah R Apotheosis to finish her before she can escape.
Seraphine.escape: When Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine R Encore are down, look for an opening to go in with Nilah E Slipstream. Seraphine has no mobility ability, so close the distance and catch her with Nilah R Apotheosis. Before engaging, check for a minion to dash to with Nilah E Slipstream so you have a way out.
Seraphine.fight: For short trades, hit a minion or Seraphine with Nilah Q Formless Blade first to increase your range and attack speed, then use basic attacks. If Seraphine is separated from an allied marksman and Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine R Encore are down, use Nilah E Slipstream to close the distance. Your physical damage hits Seraphine hard because she has low armor.
Seraphine.laning: Early on, don't force an engage against ranged Seraphine. Use Nilah Q Formless Blade to last-hit from a distance and keep up in levels. Stay near your support to benefit from bonus experience gained by last-hitting minions and the amplification of healing and shielding from allies. Even if Seraphine steps forward to hit a minion, wait to engage if Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine R Encore are available.
Seraphine.phase: From mid game, as you build critical strike items, Nilah Q Formless Blade gains penetration and life steal, improving your ability to sustain fights. In late game, help your allies survive with Nilah W Jubilant Veil and Nilah R Apotheosis.
Seraphine.teamfight: Don't engage first; wait until the enemy reaches an ally, then go in second. When the enemy's basic attacks start coming in, activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil and share its dodge effect with allies it touches. When enemies group up, pull them in with Nilah R Apotheosis and heal alongside your allies, but don't stand in a line with them to avoid the increased range of Seraphine R Encore.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns immobilized targets, so if you are slowed, move out of the line in front of Seraphine. Seraphine R Encore gains range each time it hits an allied champion, so don't stand in a line with your allies. When your health is low, watch out for Seraphine Q High Note, which deals damage based on missing health.

Sivir.build: Sivir's main damage, Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and Sivir W Ricochet, is physical, so prioritize armor. Keep building critical strike items, since Nilah Q Formless Blade gains penetration and life steal as your critical strike chance increases.
Sivir.combo: Bait out Sivir E Spell Shield first, then go in with Nilah E Slipstream and cast Nilah Q Formless Blade during the dash to hit enemies along your path as well. Follow up with basic attacks, then activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil when Sivir starts counterattacking with basic attacks. Use Nilah R Apotheosis to pull enemies together and finish the fight while Sivir E Spell Shield is down.
Sivir.escape: Sivir has no mobility ability to create distance and no crowd control ability listed here, so look to engage when Sivir E Spell Shield is down. Use Nilah E Slipstream to get on Sivir, but first check which minion or unit you can dash to on the way out.
Sivir.fight: For short trades, hit a minion or Sivir with Nilah Q Formless Blade to activate its range and attack speed bonuses, then use basic attacks. Bait out Sivir E Spell Shield first, then use Nilah E Slipstream to close the distance. When Sivir starts a counterattack with basic attacks, use Nilah W Jubilant Veil to dodge them.
Sivir.laning: Early on, don't force an engage. Use Nilah Q Formless Blade to last-hit from a distance and keep up in levels. Stay near your support to benefit from Nilah P Joy Unending's bonus experience. If you have to leave lane while Sivir is there, push the wave ahead of time or have an ally catch it so your tower doesn't take damage from her fast wave clear.
Sivir.phase: From mid game, as you build critical strike items, Nilah Q Formless Blade gains penetration and life steal, improving your ability to fight. In late-game teamfights, protect and heal your allies with Nilah W Jubilant Veil and Nilah R Apotheosis.
Sivir.teamfight: Avoid the first engage and go in second, after the enemy reaches an ally. Once Sivir E Spell Shield is down, approach her with Nilah E Slipstream and block basic attack damage with Nilah W Jubilant Veil. When the enemy team groups up, pull them together with Nilah R Apotheosis and heal your allies as well.
Sivir.watch: Sivir Q Boomerang Blade can hit on both the way out and the way back, so dodge the first hit and move out of its path on the return. Sivir E Spell Shield blocks one ability, so check that it is down before using Nilah R Apotheosis. Avoid long chases while Sivir R On The Hunt is active.

Smolder.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Smolder R MMOOOMMMM!. Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath deals true damage that resistances cannot block, as well as damage based on your max health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone. If the healing from Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! prolongs fights, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Smolder.combo: Hit a minion or Smolder with Nilah Q Formless Blade to activate its empowered effect before engaging. If Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down, use Nilah E Slipstream to go in, then cast Nilah Q Formless Blade during the dash to hit along its path and follow with basic attacks. When Smolder starts counterattacking with basic attacks, activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil, then pull him in with Nilah R Apotheosis to finish him.
Smolder.escape: Use Nilah E Slipstream to engage immediately after Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap, his only escape, goes down. If you’ve dodged Smolder W Achooo! first, you’ll also reduce the risk of getting slowed and hit by follow-up attacks. Before engaging, check for a minion you can use to retreat with Nilah E Slipstream.
Smolder.fight: When Smolder steps forward to hit minions, land Nilah Q Formless Blade first to activate its range and attack speed, then weave in a few quick basic attacks. If Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down, close the gap with Nilah E Slipstream and activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil when Smolder’s retaliatory basic attacks start coming in. If Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! lands beneath you, step out of the flames before fighting again.
Smolder.laning: Stay near your support to maintain an experience advantage while dodging Smolder W Achooo! and denying Smolder chances to scale by killing enemies with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath. Smolder is weak early, so pressure his farming with help from your support and jungler.
Smolder.phase: Nilah is weak early too, but Smolder has few stacks, so safely last-hit while pressuring his farm. In mid game, Nilah’s crit items increase her penetration and sustain, so consolidate your advantage through objectives and towers. As the game goes on, Smolder becomes increasingly favored thanks to his permanent stacks, so look for an opening to engage and take him down quickly in late game.
Smolder.teamfight: Don’t engage first; go in second, after the enemy engages on an ally. Dive in with Nilah W Jubilant Veil to dodge retaliatory basic attacks, and use Nilah R Apotheosis when enemies group up to pull them in and heal your allies. Look for the moment Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap goes down, but don’t chase recklessly through the flames from Smolder R MMOOOMMMM!.
Smolder.watch: Smolder W Achooo! explodes on champions, building stacks and slowing them, so dodge it by standing behind minions or moving to the side. Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! deals heavy damage at its center and heals Smolder, so step out of the flames, then re-engage. As Smolder scales, Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath also threatens true damage and an execute.

Tristana.combo: Engage with Nilah E Slipstream when Tristana W Rocket Jump is down and you’re no longer at risk of being knocked back by Tristana R Buster Shot. When Tristana starts counterattacking with basic attacks, activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil and finish by pulling her in with Nilah R Apotheosis.
Tristana.escape: The moment after Tristana uses Tristana W Rocket Jump is your chance to close in with Nilah E Slipstream. Delay your engage if Tristana R Buster Shot is ready. You can catch Tristana with Nilah R Apotheosis when she tries to escape with Tristana W Rocket Jump.
Tristana.fight: For short trades, hit a minion or Tristana with Nilah Q Formless Blade to empower it, then follow with basic attacks. Close the gap with Nilah E Slipstream when Tristana steps forward to hit minions. Activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil when retaliatory basic attacks start.
Tristana.laning: Stay away from allied minions so you don’t get caught in Tristana E Explosive Charge’s area damage. Gain experience together with your support and get through the laning phase without taking heavy losses.
Tristana.phase: Nilah is at a disadvantage in range and health early, so don’t overextend. From mid game, as crit items build up, Nilah Q Formless Blade’s penetration and lifesteal increase, improving your staying power in fights. Tristana is difficult to handle with a completed build, so aim to end the game before then.
Tristana.teamfight: Don’t engage first; go in second, after Tristana engages on an ally. Dodge basic attacks with Nilah W Jubilant Veil while passing by your allies to share its evasion effect. When enemies group up, pull them in with Nilah R Apotheosis to heal your allies. If an ally falls and the fight turns against you, retreat together immediately.
Tristana.watch: Don’t stand near allied minions to avoid the area damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge. When Tristana chains basic attacks with Tristana Q Rapid Fire, dodge them with Nilah W Jubilant Veil. If Tristana R Buster Shot is ready, she can knock you back or stun you, so don’t engage hastily.

TwistedFate.build: Nilah Q Formless Blade grants armor penetration and basic attack lifesteal as your crit chance increases, so prioritize crit items. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Twisted Fate’s attack damage.
TwistedFate.combo: When Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is used, engage with Nilah E Slipstream and cast Nilah Q Formless Blade during the dash to hit enemies along its path. Follow with basic attacks, then activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil when the enemy starts counterattacking with basic attacks. Finish by pulling in grouped enemies with Nilah R Apotheosis.
TwistedFate.escape: Don’t engage while Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is ready. Once the card is used and Twisted Fate R Destiny is down, look for a chance to close in with Nilah E Slipstream. Before going in, check for a minion or unit you can use to retreat with Nilah E Slipstream.
TwistedFate.fight: For short trades, hit a minion or your opponent with Nilah Q Formless Blade first to increase your range and attack speed, then follow with basic attacks. Close the gap with Nilah E Slipstream just after Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is used.
TwistedFate.laning: Don’t force an engage early. Use Nilah Q Formless Blade to secure ranged last hits and keep up in levels. Stay close to your support to benefit from the experience advantage and increased healing and shielding from Nilah P Joy Unending.
TwistedFate.phase: From mid game, as your crit items build up, Nilah Q Formless Blade’s penetration and lifesteal increase together, making you stronger. In late-game teamfights, help your allies survive with Nilah W Jubilant Veil and Nilah R Apotheosis.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Avoid the first engage; go in second, after the enemy engages on an ally. When Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is used, close in with Nilah E Slipstream. When enemies group up, pull them in with Nilah R Apotheosis to heal nearby allies as well. If you see Twisted Fate R Destiny’s movement within range, interrupt it with Nilah R Apotheosis.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate W Pick a Card has locked in a gold card, stay out of range because his next basic attack will stun you. When the card flies toward you, dodge the basic attack with Nilah W Jubilant Veil. Stand behind minions to reduce poke damage from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards.

Twitch.build: Build crit items first to increase Nilah Q Formless Blade’s penetration and lifesteal. One type of resistance offers limited protection against Twitch E Contaminate, and resistances can’t reduce the true damage from Twitch P Deadly Venom, so consider your total health too.
Twitch.combo: When Twitch steps forward and you have an opening to engage, close in with Nilah E Slipstream and cast Nilah Q Formless Blade during the dash to hit enemies along its path. Follow with basic attacks, then activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil when Twitch starts counterattacking with basic attacks. Finish by pulling him in with Nilah R Apotheosis.
Twitch.escape: After leaving the cloud from Twitch W Venom Cask, close in with Nilah E Slipstream when Twitch steps forward to hit minions. Twitch has no ability to create distance on his own, so catch him with Nilah R Apotheosis once you’re on him. Before engaging, check for a way to retreat with Nilah E Slipstream.
Twitch.fight: For short trades, hit a minion or Twitch with Nilah Q Formless Blade first to activate its range and attack speed, then follow with basic attacks. If Twitch starts counterattacking with basic attacks, dodge with Nilah W Jubilant Veil. Don’t continue trading inside the cloud from Twitch W Venom Cask.
Twitch.laning: Don’t force an engage early. Use Nilah Q Formless Blade to secure ranged last hits and keep up in levels. Stay with your support to benefit from the experience advantage from Nilah P Joy Unending, and alert your allies if Twitch disappears from lane.
Twitch.phase: From mid game, as your crit items build up, Nilah Q Formless Blade’s penetration and lifesteal increase together, making you stronger. In late game, protect your allies as you fight with Nilah W Jubilant Veil and Nilah R Apotheosis.
Twitch.teamfight: Don’t engage first; go in second, after the enemy engages on an ally. When Twitch R Spray and Pray is active, spread out to the sides instead of lining up with your allies, and dodge Twitch’s basic attacks with Nilah W Jubilant Veil. When Twitch’s camouflage ends, coordinate with your allies to focus the same target and approach, then pull in grouped enemies with Nilah R Apotheosis to heal your allies as well.
Twitch.watch: Twitch can approach with Twitch Q Ambush, so first check bushes you have no vision of and narrow paths. If Twitch W Venom Cask lands beneath you, leave the area immediately. If you’ve been hit by several basic attacks, create distance before Twitch E Contaminate hits, even if you still have health remaining.

Varus.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows. As Nilah’s crit chance increases, Nilah Q Formless Blade also gains armor penetration and basic attack lifesteal, so build crit items. Varus W Blighted Quiver deals damage based on your max health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone.
Varus.combo: When engaging, cast Nilah Q Formless Blade as Nilah E Slipstream dashes through Varus to hit enemies along its path. Follow with basic attacks, then activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil when Varus starts counterattacking with basic attacks. If enemies group up, finish by pulling them in with Nilah R Apotheosis.
Varus.escape: Varus has no mobility, so close in with Nilah E Slipstream after Varus R Chain of Corruption is down. While Varus aims Varus Q Piercing Arrow, sidestep its path and look for an opening to engage. Before going in, check for a minion you can use to retreat with Nilah E Slipstream.
Varus.fight: For short trades, hit a minion or Varus with Nilah Q Formless Blade first to gain attack speed and range, then follow with basic attacks. Dodge Varus’s basic attacks with Nilah W Jubilant Veil when he starts counterattacking. If the ground from Varus E Hail of Arrows is active, step out before fighting again.
Varus.laning: Stay close to your support to benefit from the experience advantage and increased healing and shielding. When Varus steps forward to hit minions and Varus R Chain of Corruption is down, engage with Nilah E Slipstream.
Varus.phase: In mid game, as crit items build up, Nilah Q Formless Blade’s penetration and lifesteal increase, improving your staying power in fights. In late-game teamfights, help your allies survive with Nilah W Jubilant Veil and Nilah R Apotheosis.
Varus.teamfight: Don’t engage first; go in second, after the enemy’s engage ability reaches an ally. Dive in while dodging Varus’s basic attacks with Nilah W Jubilant Veil. When enemies group up, pull them in with Nilah R Apotheosis to heal nearby allies as well. If an ally is rooted by Varus R Chain of Corruption, create distance to avoid the root spreading. Wait for Varus’s empowered window to pass after he gets a takedown or assist.
Varus.watch: If Varus hits you with an ability while stacks from Varus W Blighted Quiver are on you, they trigger damage based on your max health. After taking a few basic attacks, back off and let the stacks expire. Healing is reduced on the ground from Varus E Hail of Arrows, so don’t fight there relying on Nilah’s healing. Varus R Chain of Corruption roots you and can spread to nearby allies, so create distance if an ally is hit.

Vayne.build: Nilah Q Formless Blade grants more armor penetration and basic attack lifesteal as your crit chance increases, so prioritize crit items. Build armor against the physical damage from Vayne Q Tumble and Vayne E Condemn. Vayne W Silver Bolts’ true damage isn’t reduced by armor and scales with your max health, so don’t keep taking hits after stacking only armor or health.
Vayne.combo: Land Nilah Q Formless Blade first to activate its empowered effect. Once Vayne Q Tumble and Vayne E Condemn are down, engage with Nilah E Slipstream. Cast Nilah Q Formless Blade during the dash to hit enemies along its path, then follow with basic attacks. When Vayne starts counterattacking with basic attacks, activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil and finish by pulling the nearby Vayne in with Nilah R Apotheosis.
Vayne.escape: Immediately after you make Vayne use Vayne Q Tumble is your window to close in with Nilah E Slipstream. However, if Vayne E Condemn is ready, it can interrupt your close-range engage with a stun, so wait until Condemn is down before going in. Before going in, check for an escape route that uses a minion with Nilah E Slipstream.
Vayne.fight: For short trades, hit a minion or Vayne with Nilah Q Formless Blade first to activate its range and attack speed, then follow with basic attacks. If Vayne Q Tumble and Vayne E Condemn are both down right after she uses Tumble, close the gap with Nilah E Slipstream. When her counterattacking basic attacks start coming in, activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil to dodge basic attacks.
Vayne.laning: Stay near your support to gain the experience advantage from Nilah P Joy Unending and increase your shielding and healing. After Vayne steps forward to hit minions and uses Vayne E Condemn, pressure her with Nilah E Slipstream to disrupt her farming.
Vayne.phase: In mid game, as crit items build up, use Nilah Q Formless Blade’s penetration and lifesteal to target objectives and towers. Nilah’s teamfight contribution also grows in late game, but it becomes difficult to stop Vayne once she has her items with defensive stats alone, so aim to secure your advantage before then.
Vayne.teamfight: Don’t engage first; go in second after the enemy engages. Fight in open areas so Vayne E Condemn can’t knock you into a wall. When Vayne starts basic attacking, activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil to protect yourself and the allies you touch. When enemies group up, you can also heal nearby allies by pulling them in with Nilah R Apotheosis.
Vayne.watch: Vayne E Condemn stuns you if it knocks you into a wall, so don’t fight with your back to one. Vayne W Silver Bolts deals damage based on your max health as true damage when she stacks attacks on the same target, so after taking several hits, create distance before her next attack. When Vayne R Final Hour is active, she briefly turns invisible after Vayne Q Tumble, so use your abilities once she reappears.

Xayah.build: Xayah’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. As Nilah’s crit chance increases, Nilah Q Formless Blade gains armor penetration and basic attack lifesteal, so follow with crit items to increase your damage and sustain.
Xayah.combo: If you can, hit with Nilah Q Formless Blade before engaging to activate its empowered effect. For an all-in, engage with Nilah E Slipstream, cast Nilah Q Formless Blade during the dash, and follow with basic attacks. When Xayah starts counterattacking with basic attacks, activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil, then finish by pulling her in with Nilah R Apotheosis.
Xayah.escape: After Xayah E Bladecaller is down, you have a safe window to engage with Nilah E Slipstream. Before going in, check for a minion you can use to retreat with Nilah E Slipstream.
Xayah.fight: For short trades, hit a minion or Xayah with Nilah Q Formless Blade first to activate its empowered effect, follow with basic attacks, then back off. Change position as you trade, since feathers build up if you fight in the same spot for too long. Engage with Nilah E Slipstream after Xayah E Bladecaller is down, and activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil when her basic attacks start.
Xayah.laning: Stay near your support to gain the experience advantage from Nilah P Joy Unending and benefit from its healing and shielding effects. Fight when Xayah steps forward to hit minions and Xayah E Bladecaller is down.
Xayah.phase: In mid game, as crit items build up, Nilah Q Formless Blade’s penetration and lifesteal increase, making you stronger. In late-game teamfights, help your allies survive with Nilah W Jubilant Veil and Nilah R Apotheosis.
Xayah.teamfight: Don’t engage first; go in second, after the enemy engages on an ally. Confirm Xayah R Featherstorm is down before engaging with Nilah E Slipstream, and activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil when the basic attack damage starts coming in. When enemies group up, pull them in with Nilah R Apotheosis to heal your allies as well.
Xayah.watch: Xayah E Bladecaller roots you if you’re hit by three or more returning feathers, so watch the line between Xayah and the feathers on the ground. If three or more feathers lie along that line, move to the side instead of retreating straight back. Don’t rush your engage while Xayah R Featherstorm is ready, since Nilah E Slipstream and Nilah R Apotheosis can be avoided.

Yasuo.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. As Nilah builds crit chance, the penetration and basic attack lifesteal from Nilah Q Formless Blade increase as well.
Yasuo.combo: Before engaging, break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield with Nilah Q Formless Blade. Engage with Nilah E Slipstream, cast Nilah Q Formless Blade while dashing through, then follow up with basic attacks. When Yasuo starts a counterattack with basic attacks, activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil, then pull him in with Nilah R Apotheosis to finish him off.
Yasuo.escape: The window to engage is after Yasuo throws his tornado, resetting Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s stacks, and before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back up. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade comes back quickly, so don’t engage just because one mobility ability is down. Use Nilah E Slipstream to approach in this window and pull him in with Nilah R Apotheosis, but first check for a unit you can dash through to escape.
Yasuo.fight: Use cheap poke to break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield before starting a trade. Hit a minion or Yasuo with Nilah Q Formless Blade to activate its empowered effect, then follow up with basic attacks. Close the distance with Nilah E Slipstream when Yasuo has just used his tornado and can’t knock you up for a short time.
Yasuo.laning: Keep a thin minion wave on your side to reduce the number of minions Yasuo can dash through with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Stay close to your support to make the most of the experience, shield, and healing benefits from Nilah P Joy Unending.
Yasuo.phase: From mid game, as you build crit items, Nilah Q Formless Blade’s penetration and lifesteal increase, making you stronger in extended fights. In late-game teamfights, help your allies with Nilah W Jubilant Veil and Nilah R Apotheosis.
Yasuo.teamfight: Avoid the first engage and go in second, after Yasuo has committed onto your allies. Use Nilah W Jubilant Veil to avoid his basic attack damage and pass by your allies to share its dodge effect. When enemies group up, pull them in with Nilah R Apotheosis and heal alongside your allies. Cast Nilah Q Formless Blade during Nilah E Slipstream to hit enemies along your path as well.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest can knock you up with a tornado after two consecutive hits. When you see the stack effect, move out of its line and dodge to the side. Yasuo R Last Breath also involves a knock-up, so don’t engage first with Nilah E Slipstream while the crowd control from these two abilities is available.

Zeri.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Zeri Q Burst Fire and Zeri W Ultrashock Laser. Zeri P Living Battery and Zeri E Spark Surge deal magic damage, while Zeri R Lightning Crash deals both damage types, so armor alone can’t block all her damage. Nilah Q Formless Blade gains penetration and basic attack lifesteal as your crit chance increases, so build crit items too.
Zeri.combo: After Zeri E Spark Surge is down, engage with Nilah E Slipstream and cast Nilah Q Formless Blade during the dash to hit enemies along its path. Follow with basic attacks, then activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil when Zeri starts counterattacking with basic attacks. Finish by pulling her in with Nilah R Apotheosis before she escapes.
Zeri.escape: The moment after Zeri E Spark Surge is down is your chance to engage with Nilah E Slipstream. You also need Nilah E Slipstream to disengage, so check which unit you can dash to on your way out before going in. Fight in open terrain where it’s easier to dodge Zeri W Ultrashock Laser.
Zeri.fight: For short trades, hit a minion or Zeri with Nilah Q Formless Blade first to increase your range and attack speed, then follow with basic attacks. If Zeri E Spark Surge is down, close the gap with Nilah E Slipstream, and activate Nilah W Jubilant Veil when Zeri starts counterattacking with basic attacks.
Zeri.laning: Look to engage with Nilah E Slipstream after Zeri steps forward to hit minions and uses Zeri E Spark Surge. Stay in lane with your support to benefit from the experience advantage from Nilah P Joy Unending.
Zeri.phase: In mid game, Nilah Q Formless Blade’s penetration and lifesteal increase as crit items build up, but Zeri also becomes difficult to catch once she has her core items because of her mobility. In late game, protect your allies and contribute to teamfights with Nilah W Jubilant Veil and Nilah R Apotheosis.
Zeri.teamfight: Don’t engage first; go in second, after the enemy’s engage ability reaches an ally. Dodge basic attacks with Nilah W Jubilant Veil while passing by your allies to share its evasion effect. When enemies group up, pull them in with Nilah R Apotheosis to heal your allies as well, and don’t chase Zeri on foot while Zeri R Lightning Crash is active.
Zeri.watch: Zeri W Ultrashock Laser spreads widely when it hits terrain, so don’t face her with your back to a wall or in a narrow passage. Zeri E Spark Surge travels farther when crossing a wall, so don’t corner her toward one. After Zeri R Lightning Crash is active, her movement speed increases, so don’t chase on foot.
